records.exact_source_text:
簡文在暗室中坐召宣武宣武至問上何在簡文曰
某在斯時人以為能
records.semantic_basis: The selected first 宣武 is syntactically the object of 召. It denotes 桓溫 as a person participating in the main-text summoning event; it is not itself a direct-address or vocative occurrence. A grammatical object of a summoning, remonstrance, or communication verb is not automatically an addressee.
records.gold_mutation: expected_narrative_function addressee -> participant; expected_legacy_occurrence_role addressee_reference -> scene_participant
